mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_analysis (bid_record_id, bidder_name, risk_level, summary, suggestions, raw_response, prompt_version) VALUES (#{bidRecordId}, #{bidderName}, #{riskLevel}, #{summary}, #{suggestions}, #{rawResponse}, #{promptVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT analysis_id, bid_record_id, bidder_name, risk_level, summary, suggestions, raw_response, prompt_version, analyzed_at FROM risk_analysis WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId}
